title: SARS Auto-Assessment Calculator payslip import format
description: Bulk payslip line-item data importable into the wizard's Payslips step. This is the single source of truth both the web app (src/lib/import/payslipImportSchema.ts) and the local payslip-extractor tool validate against, so JSON produced by either side is guaranteed to work with the other.

taxYear.description: SA tax year, e.g. "2025/26". If present, must match the tax year selected in the app.

month.description: ISO year-month, e.g. "2025-03". Must fall within the March-February span of the given tax year.

sarsCode.description: Real SARS IRP5 source code, e.g. "3601", if known.
